narrative.en: This 10-card reading opens with Page of Wands at “Core situation” and closes with Six of Cups at “If the current pattern continues”. Between them, Knight of Wands at “Primary tension”, Queen of Wands at “What you consciously understand”, King of Wands at “A deeper driver to examine”, Ace of Cups at “What has already shaped the situation”, Two of Cups at “What is beginning to emerge”, Three of Cups at “Your position in it”, Four of Cups at “Environment / others’ visible role”, Five of Cups at “Hopes and concerns” add intermediate lenses that should be read in relation to the question. Read the spread as a sequence of perspectives on the same question rather than 10 independent verdicts. The structural patterns above are comparison cues, not additional facts.
